qualification: Studio-authored report themes. Each file is SHA-256 pinned and registered with the PBIR customTheme contract; a theme changes colors and text styles only, never data, bindings or layout. Palettes were written for Studio; no third-party theme file is included.

themes.label: Power BI default
themes.use_when: No particular visual identity is requested; keep Power BI's built-in base theme.

themes.label: Executive light
themes.use_when: Polished leadership or client-facing reporting with a blue and orange accent.

themes.label: Calm teal
themes.use_when: Operational, service, health or sustainability reporting that should feel calm and neutral.

themes.label: Finance neutral
themes.use_when: Finance, variance or IBCS-style reporting: greys for context, one blue accent, green and red only for good and bad.

themes.label: Accessible contrast
themes.use_when: Color-vision-deficiency-safe palette (Okabe-Ito order) with high text contrast.
